tasks.name: הקטן מבין שניים
tasks.note: Returns the smaller of the two inputs.

tasks.name: לא-וגם
tasks.note: Returns the bitwise NAND of the two inputs on four bits.

tasks.name: כיבוי הביט הנמוך
tasks.note: Clears the lowest bit of a, rounding it down to an even number.

tasks.name: פחות שלוש ברצפה
tasks.note: Subtracts 3 from a, never going below 0.

tasks.name: זוגי או לא
tasks.note: Flags 15 when a is even, else 0.

tasks.name: כפול עד 15
tasks.note: Doubles a, saturating at 15.

tasks.name: סכום שלושה עד 15
tasks.note: Adds the three inputs, saturating at 15.

tasks.name: מרחק משמונה
tasks.note: Returns the distance of a from 8.

tasks.name: בחירה לפי זוגיות
tasks.note: Returns a when a is even, otherwise b.

tasks.name: ועוד חמש מעגלי
tasks.note: Adds 5 to a modulo 16.

tasks.name: שליש
tasks.note: Divides a by 3, rounding down.

tasks.name: גודל הטווח
tasks.note: Counts the whole numbers from a to b inclusive, 0 when b is below a, capped at 15.

tasks.name: עיגול למעלה לשלוש
tasks.note: Rounds a up to a multiple of 3, capped at 15.

tasks.name: ממוצע כלפי מעלה
tasks.note: Returns the average of the two inputs rounded up.

tasks.name: סך ביטים בשניים
tasks.note: Counts the set bits of both inputs together.

tasks.name: מקסימום או מינימום
tasks.note: Returns the larger of a and b when c is odd, the smaller when c is even.

tasks.name: ספרות בבסיס 4
tasks.note: Sums the two base-4 digits of a.

tasks.name: עד כפולה של 4
tasks.note: Returns how much must be added to a to reach a multiple of 4.

tasks.name: האיבר הבא בסדרה
tasks.note: Continues the arithmetic sequence a, b by one step, modulo 16.

tasks.name: סיבוב ביט שמאלה
tasks.note: Rotates the four bits of a left by one place.

tasks.name: ריבוע ההפרש
tasks.note: Returns the squared difference of the inputs, capped at 15.

tasks.name: ממוצע משוקלל
tasks.note: Returns three quarters of a plus one quarter of b, rounded down.

tasks.name: חסימה בין שניים
tasks.note: Raises a to at least b, then lowers the result to at most c.

tasks.name: החזקה הגדולה של 2
tasks.src: a=>{ let p=0; for(let q=1;q<=a;q*=2) p=q; return p; }
tasks.note: Returns the largest power of two not above a, or 0 for zero.

tasks.name: צעדים לאפס
tasks.src: a=>{ let n=0; while(a){ a=a&1?a-1:a>>1; n++; } return n; }
tasks.note: Counts steps to reach 0 when odd numbers drop by one and even numbers are halved.

tasks.name: כמה ראשוניים עד
tasks.src: a=>{ let c=0; for(let n=2;n<=a;n++){ let p=true; for(let d=2;d*d<=n;d++) if(n%d===0) p=false; if(p) c++; } return c; }
tasks.note: Counts the primes up to and including a.

tasks.name: המחלק הגדול
tasks.src: a=>{ for(let d=a-1;d>1;d--) if(a%d===0) return d; return a>1?1:0; }
tasks.note: Returns the largest divisor of a below a itself, or 0 for 0 and 1.

tasks.name: צעדי אוקלידס
tasks.src: (a,b)=>{ let n=0; while(b){ const t=a%b; a=b; b=t; n++; } return n; }
tasks.note: Counts the remainder steps Euclid's algorithm takes on a and b.

tasks.name: סכום ספרות בבסיס 3
tasks.src: a=>{ let s=0; while(a){ s+=a%3; a=Math.floor(a/3); } return s; }
tasks.note: Sums the base-3 digits of a.

tasks.name: פיבונאצ׳י מוכלל
tasks.src: (a,b,c)=>{ let x=a, y=b; for(let i=0;i<c;i++){ const t=(x+y)&15; x=y; y=t; } return x; }
tasks.note: Returns term c of the sequence starting a, b where each term is the sum of the two before it, modulo 16.

tasks.name: אורך מסלול לינארי
tasks.src: (a,b,c)=>{ const seen=new Set(); let x=c; while(!seen.has(x)){ seen.add(x); x=(a*x+b)&15; } return Math.min(15,seen.size); }
tasks.note: Iterates x to a times x plus b modulo 16 from c and counts distinct values before a repeat, capped at 15.

tasks.name: מקום בין שווי ביטים
tasks.src: a=>{ const pc=x=>(x&1)+(x>>1&1)+(x>>2&1)+(x>>3&1); let c=0; for(let x=0;x<a;x++) if(pc(x)===pc(a)) c++; return c; }
tasks.note: Counts smaller numbers that have the same number of set bits as a.

tasks.name: שורש ספרתי של מכפלה
tasks.note: Returns the repeated decimal digit sum of a times b, or 0 when the product is zero.

tasks.name: דרכים לשלם
tasks.src: a=>{ let c=0; for(let z=0;5*z<=a;z++) for(let y=0;5*z+3*y<=a;y++) c++; return c; }
tasks.note: Counts ways to pay a using coins of 1, 3 and 5.
